response.sql: WITH matched_fees AS (SELECT f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.mktnote FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), fees_with_net AS (SELECT mktnote, (feerate - rebrate) as net_fee_rate FROM matched_fees), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) as benchmark_rate FROM fees_with_net), pair_stats AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) as pair_avg_rate FROM fees_with_net GROUP BY mktnote), above_benchmark AS (SELECT pair_avg_rate, (pair_avg_rate - benchmark_rate) as excess FROM pair_stats CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE benchmark_rate IS NOT NULL AND pair_avg_rate > benchmark_rate) SELECT AVG(pair_avg_rate) as avg_of_pair_averages, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in feerate or rebrate produce NULL net_fee_rate, which are skipped by AVG() per the 'skip missing values' directive. If all matched fees lack both non-NULL values, benchmark becomes NULL and the result is NULL (satisfying 'if benchmark is missing, keep none').
